en: ...Huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>The innertube isn't here...
Did Monokuma put it away?
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>This doesn't look like a normal school pool...
more like a pool at a resort.

<CLT=cltMIND>The pool is deep, but it isn't filled
up all the way. Still, plenty of water to swim in.

<CLT=cltMIND>The water level was one piece of
evidence I used to solve the case...

<CLT=cltMIND>This is a storage room.
There's a lot of pool equipment inside.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's the gym window...

<CLT=cltMIND>This window and the one on the school
building face each other.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure it's just coincidence, but...
some part of me thinks it was intentional.

<CLT=cltMIND>All of the school's windows are
blocked off...

<CLT=cltMIND>...except for the one
in Ryoma's lab.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a large diving board.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is also something you would
find at a resort...
<CLT=cltMIND>Some pool rules are posted here.
Swimming is prohibited during nighttime.

<CLT=cltMIND>That one rule spoiled Kirumi's
otherwise-perfect crime...

<CLT=cltMIND>But I don't plan on thanking Monokuma
or the Monokubs for that.
